## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm test`, and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] Accessibility considered: keyboard + screen-reader navigable, AA contrast, reduced-motion respected
- [ ] Only open-access (public domain / CC0) art is surfaced; credit is preserved
- [ ] Tests added or updated for behaviour changes
- [ ] Docs / CHANGELOG updated if relevant
